alt: 兩個人在別人背後低聲說壞話，被議論的人還在遠處專心做事，並不知道有人暗中中傷。
scene_prompt: 含沙射影 means indirectly and maliciously harming someone's reputation through insinuation. Modern shared school art studio with older teenagers. Foreground one teen cups a hand and whispers maliciously to another, sly glance directed toward an absent-from-the-conversation student working earnestly in the background. A single picture-only whisper bubble contains a small distorted dark silhouette resembling that innocent student's hairstyle, surrounded by tiny thorn-like marks, suggesting negative insinuations; no writing, letters, slurs or literal arrows. The listener looks doubtful, not delighted. Make secret backbiting and the unaware target visible in one frame, no sand monster, no violence, no recognizable people.
